notes: Corrected backplate PCIe slot counts against NetApp's own 'Key specifications' pages (direct-fetched 2026-08-10, tracked in a separate reference library): AFF/ASA A70, A90, and A1K actually have 9 PCIe expansion slots per controller, not 11 as previously rendered. AFF A900 is a distinct platform from A400 -- A900 has 10 PCIe slots per controller (8U chassis), A400 has 5 (4U chassis) -- previously both were incorrectly rendered identically as a single 10-slot layout. AFX's disaggregated architecture does have a confirmed fixed slot map after all (slot 1 = HA replication, slot 7 = cluster replication, slots 10-11 = storage-shelf fabric, per NetApp's own AFX hardware-details documentation) -- restored the slot-numbered layout for AFX specifically with the now-confirmed real assignments, distinct from the corrected 9-slot A70/A90/A1K layout. Found and fixed a real platform-detection bug while implementing this: AFF A900 was being misclassified into the A70/A90/A1K bucket because the string 'a90' is a substring of 'a900' -- confirmed via live testing before this fix, and caught the same class of bug for fas90/fas9000. Also independently reconfirmed the MetroCluster ISL packet-loss (<=0.01%) and jitter (<=3ms round-trip) requirements against NetApp's current ISL requirements documentation -- no changes needed, values were already correct.
